map.Clark 和 Young 公式哪个更准？: Which is more accurate, the Clark or the Young formula?
map.Clark（按体重）在较大儿童更接近实际，Young（按年龄）对婴幼儿粗略可用。: Clark (by weight) is closer to reality in older children, while Young (by age) is roughly usable for infants. Both are empirical estimates only: for precise dosing follow the "mg/kg by weight" on the drug label, note that maximum daily doses differ by drug, and never scale an adult dose by a simple ratio.

map.对照最大日剂量上限，识别超量风险（尤其退烧/抗生素类）。: Check against the maximum daily dose to identify overdose risk, especially for antipyretics and antibiotics.
map.所有儿童用药须经医生/药师按体重与年龄核算，并使用带刻度的量具（非汤匙）给药: All paediatric medication must be calculated by a doctor or pharmacist from weight and age, and given with a graduated measure (not a spoon)
map.按体重(Clark)或年龄(Young)将成人剂量折算为儿童每次剂量，避免凭经验: Scale an adult dose to a per-dose child dose by weight (Clark) or age (Young), avoiding dosing from experience.
map.结合药品浓度把 mg 剂量换算为可量取的 ml 体积，减少给药误差。: Combine the solution concentration to convert a mg dose into a measurable ml volume, reducing dosing error.
